name: forge_v2
note: the delivered forge v2 finals as render blocks (earshot.forge.schema); every entry re-rendered its WAV within one 24-bit step when this file was built

click.target: a clean bright user interface click
click.use: cursor presses and buttons: a short modal tick with a small body

downlifter.target: a downlifter sound effect: a sinking filtered sweep
downlifter.use: energy falling away after a hit, scene exits

glitch.target: a short digital glitch stutter with bit-crushed noise bursts that speed up and cut off

hover_tick.target: a tiny high soft tick when the cursor hovers over a button
hover_tick.use: hover, list rows passing, tiny ticks

impact.use: a cinematic hit: reveal, title slam (long tails: trim with dur or max_s)

logo_sting.target: a short bright logo reveal sting: a whoosh into a hit with a shimmering chime
logo_sting.use: a composite logo reveal (lead-in + hit + chime)

notify.use: struck bell chimes (A4-E6): success, a message, a soft lockup

pop.use: bubble and cork pops (the bubble rises in pitch)

pro_click.target: a crisp high digital interface tick for a product video

pro_glitch.target: a short digital glitch stutter with bit-crushed noise bursts that speed up and cut off
pro_glitch.use: a designed stutter ending on the cut

pro_hover_tick.target: a tiny airy digital tick for an interface animation
pro_hover_tick.use: airy digital ticks: cursor blinks, counters

pro_impact.target: a deep designed sub impact with a granular rumble tail, gated

pro_logo_sting.target: a designed logo sting: a falling chirp landing on a low hum
pro_logo_sting.use: designed launch gestures onto a tone

pro_notify.use: short clean dings a semitone apart

pro_pop.use: tonal pops for a word or badge appearing

pro_pop_in.target: a soft round low pop as an icon appears on screen
pro_pop_in.use: an icon or element popping in: a round low thump

pro_riser.target: a short stuttering digital riser into a cut
pro_riser.use: a short stutter riser into a cut

pro_sub_drop.target: a designed sub drop: a low sine falling under a bright click
pro_sub_drop.use: the designed low drop that blooms after the cut

pro_tap.target: a soft low thump of a finger touching a screen
pro_tap.use: the soft low thump of a touch

pro_typing_key.target: a short crisp high-passed digital typing tick for a motion graphics title
pro_typing_key.use: high-passed designed ticks for kinetic type

pro_typing_run.target: a quick run of crisp high-passed digital typing ticks for an animated title
pro_typing_run.use: a whole typed run as one file

pro_whoosh_big.target: a deep low designed whoosh swell
pro_whoosh_big.use: a designed low sub swell into a cut

pro_zip.target: a quick tonal zip, a fast synth pitch sweep
pro_zip.use: tonal sweeps across a cut (up / arc members rise in pitch)

riser.target: a cinematic riser building tension into a hit
riser.use: a build into a reveal; it stops on its loudest sample

shimmer.target: bar chimes and wind chimes ringing out

sub_drop.use: weight under a hit, a music drop

swipe.use: card and panel swipes, page turns (cloth, paper)

swish.target: a thin quick swish of a cane through the air
swish.use: thin quick flicks, text slides, small UI moves

tap.target: a soft low thump of a finger touching a screen
tap.use: screen taps and light touches on a surface

toggle.target: a small switch flipped on with two quick clicks

typing_key.target: a single mechanical keyboard key press with a crisp click and a short thock
typing_key.use: realistic mechanical keys, one take per character

whoosh_big.use: big scene transitions, large objects passing

whoosh_fast.use: whip pans, fast fly-ins, element moves
